title: The Eiffel Tower
text:
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris, France. It is very tall. It is made of iron. Many people visit it every year.

The tower was built in 1889. It was made for a big fair. Today, you can climb the stairs or take an elevator to the top.

questions.text: Why do many people visit the tower every year?
options: Because it is a famous and special place
Because it is a small house
Because it is made of wood
Because it is near a river

questions.text: What can you infer about the size of the tower?
options: It is very big and tall
It is the same as a house

vocabulary.definition: an event with games, shows and things to buy
a machine that carries people up and down in a building

paragraph_translations: La Torre Eiffel está en París, Francia. Es muy alta. Está hecha de hierro. Mucha gente la visita cada año.
La torre fue construida en 1889. Fue hecha para una gran feria. Hoy, puedes subir las escaleras o tomar un ascensor hasta la cima.
